## Checklist

- [ ] Entries follow the format in CONTRIBUTING.md and sit in the right category and sub-header.
- [ ] No duplicates: `python3 scripts/check_duplicates.py` passes.
- [ ] Counts updated: `python3 scripts/count_entries.py --write`.
- [ ] Markdown lint passes: `npx markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"`.
- [ ] Every new link was opened, loads and matches the idea (no invented repos or stats).
- [ ] Fork suggestions: licence, stars and archive status come from the GitHub API, with the date checked.
